name: Attached To Detector
description: A GuardDuty filter, trusted IP list, threat intelligence set, publishing destination or member account belongs to one GuardDuty detector (object -> detector): the detector the call was made under, named by the detector node's key (account, region and detector id). The `_TO` is the locative preposition of 'attached to', not a direction marker. A reference, not containment. Emitted whether or not the detector node was collected: it resolves by deterministic identity when it is.
